verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for an analytics platform like PostHog, covering either its own CLI/wizard/MCP telemetry or SDK-level opt-out for end users. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an opt-out setting, a do-not-track control, or a telemetry-disable flag. The self-hosting and MIT-license items describe deployment options, not a telemetry opt-out, so they cannot be credited here.
